messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Alex Santos <alex.santos@vegalabs.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Vega pilot: provisioning handshake + contingency asks

Folks — looping product/ops ahead of Vega Labs' pilot next week. Alex, thanks again for the heads up during the call; they're expecting a phased ramp starting Tue 6/1 with a big spike on day 3 for an internal demo. Quick summary and asks below so we can align on quota and fallback: 

- Vega's expected concurrent QPS (p95): 180 requests/sec for a 20-minute demo window on day 3; baseline is ~40 req/sec. See attached estimates.
- Primary ask: temporary rate window bump to support a short burst to 200 QPS for the demo window (6/3 17:00-17:30 PT).
- Secondary ask: a failover route to a lower-cost quantized model (same API surface) if latency spikes > 200ms for > 2 minutes.
- Product asks: confirm whether model pinning + automatic fallback to a quantized variant is feasible without changing client code.
- Ops asks: what lead time and approvals do we need for a temporary quota override and what telemetry/alerts we should expect during the window.

I don't need a final sign-off yet — just please call out any blockers and whether the contingency flow proposed above is realistic. Alex, if you can confirm the exact demo window timezone and an engineering contact on your side (for a quick warmup test), that'd be great.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vega_peak_traffic_estimates.xlsx
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Alex Santos <alex.santos@vegalabs.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vega pilot: provisioning handshake + contingency asks

Thanks for the summary, Karthik. Quick product-side responses: 

- Model fallback: yes — we can implement transparent fallback to a quantized variant (same endpoint) using routing policy. Client code unchanged. We'll need to register the quantized model variant in the catalog and tag it as "compatible-fallback". That takes ~24 hours to onboard and smoke test.
- Signal for fallback: we can base on p50/p95 latency thresholds and error rate. Suggest threshold = p95 > 220ms OR 5% 5xx over a 2-minute window.
- Can we avoid semantic regressions? We'll run a short 100-prompt eval set (please provide ~100 representative prompts) to flag major deltas.

Product asks for Vega: please provide one representative conversation sample per supported route (chat/generate) so we can run the quick eval. Alex — if you can drop those into the Drive link Priya referenced, we can start.

Priya Natarajan
Group PM, Serving
Redwood Inference

Thanks — confirming details from our side: 

- Demo window is 2026-06-03 17:00-17:30 PT (that's correct).
- Engineering contact: platform-eng@vegalabs.com (cc'd in this thread). They will do a brief warmup on 6/2 at 09:00 PT (10 minutes, light traffic) and another 30-min warmup on 6/3 at 15:30 PT.
- We can provide 120 sample prompts (chat and completion mix) by EOD today; I'll upload to your Drive folder.
- On the fallback: we accept potential slight quality delta for the demo but want a clear rollback path if the quantized variant shows >15% semantic drift on the eval set.

Alex Santos
Head of Integrations
Vega Labs

Looping ops/runbook — short operational plan below and next steps. I've attached a short contingency playbook.

Operational plan (high level):
- Temporary quota: approve a scoped temporary quota increase to 200 QPS for 6/3 16:45-17:45 PT (covers warmup + demo window). Note: the quota window requires Engineering + Finance notification; I'll handle the approvals today.
- Warmups: ops will monitor warmup traffic at 6/2 09:00 PT and 6/3 15:30 PT. Platform-eng (Vega) should provide a single bearer token for warmup tests.
- Telemetry & alerts: we'll create a dedicated dashboard and set alerts for latency p95 > 200ms and error rate > 3% during the window; ops pager at 1min.
- Fallback invocation: if p95 > 220ms for 2 continuous minutes OR error rate > 5% for 2 minutes, ops will flip routing to the quantized variant and notify Vega&CS.
- Post-demo: auto revert quota after 60 minutes unless product requests an extension. We'll run the eval artifacts against the quantized model post-demo and share semantic drift metrics within 4 hours.

Next steps / action items:
1) Alex/Vega: upload the 120 sample prompts + confirm bearer token for warmups — due EOD 5/28.
2) Priya/Product: onboard quantized variant and run the 100-prompt smoke eval — due 5/29 EOD.
3) Ops (Neha): provision temp quota and dashboard; confirm approvals — due 5/28 EOD.

Attachments: vega_contingency_playbook.pdf

Thanks — I will post the dashboard link once live.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
